Inspection report: St Barnabas’ Church of England Primary School 28 February and 1 March 2023 6 ◼ Inspectors carried out deep dives in early reading, mathematics, geography and art.
In most subjects, teachers follow leaders’ curriculum thinking carefully and ensure that pupils learn and remember the planned curriculum.
Leaders should make sure that the intended curriculum is implemented faithfully in these subjects, so that pupils deepen their knowledge and understanding.
The impact of this work is evident in strong pupil outcomes in reading, writing and mathematics at the end of Year 6.

signals.text: A Collective Worship programme is carefully prepared and followed to enable the opportunity for reflection on The School Vision and Values, the Church of England Liturgical Calendar and other Secular and World Faith celebrations.
A strong culture of respect and inclusivity is at the heart of the school’s vision.
Pupils speak of the importance of kindness and the behaviour policy guided by the vision promotes good relationships.
